name: An NPC talked to by one player still fights another (run with npc-talk-fight-test2.json on the other VM at the same time): once test2 stands on its tile, test spawns a monk beside it, test2 talks to the monk and leaves the chat open, and test shoots the monk from 4 tiles; the monk walks over and hits back, and only then does test tell test2 to close its chat. Exploit review round 10, NPC-1
